The second is which parts of those tests depend on physical postulates, which depend on the mathematical carrier, and which depend on logic, infinity, or existence principles. The framework treats a physical conclusion as a typed judgement

passages.rendered_html: Mannheim conformal gravity

passages.text: Mannheim’s programme uses conformal gravity to address galactic rotation without particle dark matter. The linear radial term is genuinely part of the fourth-order vacuum solution. But explaining observations requires more than showing that the term exists. One must decide how matter gets mass, which conformal frame massive bodies follow, what is sourced locally, and what is a global boundary contribution.
